title: Welcome to
name: Eternity
subtitle: This is the beginning of our story, and you may call me Bernie
introHeading: Creator, Developer, and to bear it all
introContent: Welcome to my personal homepage. Here I'll showcase my various creations, project portfolios, and links to the platforms I'm currently using. As you can see, this is a space I've created that's uniquely my own. The reason I call it "Eternity" might sound a bit childish, but for me, this term holds special meaning—it symbolizes my story, my efforts, and my U.E.P. That's all. If you'd like to contact me or offer suggestions for improvement, you can find ways to reach me here.
